scripts.build: rm -rf ./dist && tsc && vite build --mode preprod && mkdir -p ./dist/keys ./dist/zkir && (cp -r ../contract/src/managed/anonymous-survey/keys/* ./dist/keys/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r ../contract/src/managed/anonymous-survey/zkir/* ./dist/zkir/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:preview: rm -rf ./dist && tsc && vite build --mode preview && mkdir -p ./dist/keys ./dist/zkir && (cp -r ../contract/src/managed/anonymous-survey/keys/* ./dist/keys/ 2>/dev/null || true) && (cp -r ../contract/src/managed/anonymous-survey/zkir/* ./dist/zkir/ 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.build:start: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.build:start:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run start
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
